Individuals Facing Spiritual Blockages: You feel held back by unseen energies, persistent negativity, or "Astral Attacks" and are looking for a divine shield of protection.
Those Struggling with Mental Heavyweights: You are seeking relief from chronic anxiety, depression, or deep-rooted psychological disturbances through spiritual intervention.
People Dealing with Lineage Patterns: You suspect that ancestral disturbances or Pitra Doshas are affecting your current life progress and want to cleanse your bloodline's energy.
Those Seeking Physical & Emotional Relief: You want to release deep-seated pain and stagnant energy stored within your physical and astral cells.
Seekers of Astral Awakening: You desire to move beyond physical limitations and explore the deep science of the Third Eye and the Astral Body.

FAQ'S
What exactly is Asha Kaya?

It is a specialized 3-day spiritual immersion designed to cleanse the physical body ( Kaya ) and the five elements ( Tattvas ). It combines ancient Vedic techniques with cellular energy healing to remove “astral negativity” that blocks personal and spiritual growth.
Is 3 days enough time to see real results?

Yes. This program is built on the principle of “Spiritual Compression.” By following the precise guidance of Dr. Parikshit Ghotia, we use high-intensity practices to trigger shifts in 72 hours that would typically take months of casual practice to achieve.
Can I Attend Asha Kaya Every Monday Again and Again?
Yes, absolutely.

If you experience positive results from your first Asha Kaya session and feel satisfied after the screening process, you can choose to enroll in Asha Ambience . Once you become an Asha Ambience member, you will receive lifetime access to attend Asha Kaya every Monday , allowing you to continue your spiritual journey and deepen your experience over time.

As a special gift for new Asha Kaya participants, Asha Ambience is available at 50% off , making it easier to become a part of this ongoing spiritual community and enjoy lifelong access to Asha Kaya sessions.
I am a beginner. Can I participate?

Absolutely. While the energy is intense, the practices are guided step-by-step. Whether you are a seasoned seeker or just starting your journey, the divine protection of Hanuman Ji Maharaj ensures a safe and transformative experience for everyone.
Who is the founder, and what is the lineage?

The program was crafted by Dr. Parikshit Ghotia , founder of Ashaeiynn. Every aspect of this Sadhana has been developed under the spiritual guidance of Gurudev Hanuman Ji Maharaj , ensuring the practices are both authentic and divinely protected.
Do I need any special equipment or prior knowledge?
No special equipment is required. Once you register, you will receive a preparation guide that outlines everything you need to know to get the most out of your 3-day journey.
How is "Asha Kaya" different from regular yoga or meditation?

While traditional yoga focuses on physical postures and meditation on mental stillness, Asha Kaya is an “Elemental Intervention.” We work directly with the five elements ( Tattvas ) at a cellular level. It is a targeted process of purging deep-seated astral negativity that standard practices often take years to reach.
Is this a physical workshop, or can I join from my own home?

This is a fully online program conducted via live Zoom meetings . This digital format allows you to engage in the 3-day Kaya Tattva Sadhana from any location, ensuring you can practice in your own sacred space while remaining virtually and energetically connected to Dr. Parikshit Ghotia and the entire group.
What kind of "shifts" should I expect after 72 hours?

Participants typically report a profound sense of “lightness,” as if a heavy weight has been lifted. You may notice sudden clarity in decision-making, a natural reduction in stress/anxiety, and a more compassionate, balanced approach to your personal relationships.
Do I need to follow a specific diet during these 3 days?

To achieve the best results in such a short time, we recommend a Sattvic (pure, plant-based) diet. Upon registration, you will receive a “Sadhana Protocol” that includes simple dietary suggestions to help your body remain receptive to high-frequency energy.
